<!-- Included by report.qmd. Shares its params. Robustness of the total index to the data it
rests on (config ROBUSTNESS and LATE_COMPONENTS): whole-station subsampling within years,
start-year peels, the terminal year without data that usually arrive late, and down-weighting
of years with a known problem. Each run refits the selected model on a fresh mesh at the same
cutoff (refit_on()); a barrier mesh is not rebuilt there. These are diagnostics of the final
model, never criteria for choosing it. -->

```{r, eval=params$include_robustness}
#| label: fig-robustness-section-runs
#| fig-cap: "Total index under station subsampling (A), start-year peels (B) and, where configured, the terminal year without late-arriving data (C) and down-weighted years (D), each panel with the full model. Every run is rescaled to its mean over the years it shares with the full model."
#| fig-height: 8
#| output: asis
cat("## Robustness\n\n")
fit_total <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "model-fit-total.rds"))
rob <- cfg$ROBUSTNESS %||% list()
rob_index <- function(fit) predict_index(fit, grid, area = grid_cell_area_nmi2,
                                         bias_correct = FALSE)
base_index <- rob_index(fit_total)
rescale_to_base <- function(index, run, panel, replicate = 1L) {
  shared <- intersect(index$year, base_index$year)
  dplyr::mutate(index, relative = est / mean(est[year %in% shared]), run = run, panel = panel,
                replicate = replicate)
}
runs <- list(rescale_to_base(base_index, "full model", "all"))

# A. Whole stations within each year, so no station is split.
for (p in unlist(rob$subsample_props %||% c(0.5, 0.75, 0.9))) {
  for (r in seq_len(rob$subsample_reps %||% 5)) {
    f <- refit_on(fit_total, subsample_stations(dt, p, seed = r), cutoff = cfg$MESH_CUTOFF_KM)
    runs[[length(runs) + 1]] <- rescale_to_base(rob_index(f), paste0(100 * p, "% stations"), "A", r)
  }
}
# B. Drop the first 1..n years.
for (k in seq_len(rob$start_year_peels %||% 3)) {
  f <- refit_on(fit_total, dplyr::filter(dt, year >= min(dt$year) + k), cutoff = cfg$MESH_CUTOFF_KM)
  runs[[length(runs) + 1]] <- rescale_to_base(rob_index(f), paste("from", min(dt$year) + k), "B")
}
# C. The terminal year as it would look if the late-arriving component were missing.
late <- cfg$LATE_COMPONENTS
if (!is.null(late) && length(late$values)) {
  if (!late$column %in% names(dt)) stop("LATE_COMPONENTS column '", late$column, "' is not in the data.")
  dt_late <- dplyr::filter(dt, !(year == max(year) & .data[[late$column]] %in% late$values))
  f <- refit_on(fit_total, dt_late, cutoff = cfg$MESH_CUTOFF_KM)
  runs[[length(runs) + 1]] <- rescale_to_base(rob_index(f), "terminal year without late data", "C")
}
# D. Down-weight years with a known problem (weights act on the likelihood, not the data).
dw_years <- unlist(rob$downweight_years)
if (length(dw_years)) {
  w <- ifelse(fit_total$data$year %in% dw_years, rob$downweight_value %||% 0.1, 1)
  f <- update(fit_total, weights = w)
  runs[[length(runs) + 1]] <- rescale_to_base(rob_index(f),
    paste("weight", rob$downweight_value %||% 0.1, "in", paste(dw_years, collapse = ", ")), "D")
}
robustness <- dplyr::bind_rows(runs)
saveRDS(robustness, file.path(out_dir, "robustness.rds"))

full <- dplyr::filter(robustness, panel == "all") |> dplyr::select(year, full = relative)
panels <- setdiff(unique(robustness$panel), "all")
plot_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(panels, function(pn) dplyr::bind_rows(
  dplyr::filter(robustness, panel == pn),
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::filter(robustness, panel == "all"), panel = pn)
)))
print(
  ggplot2::ggplot(plot_data, ggplot2::aes(year, relative, group = interaction(run, replicate),
                                          colour = run)) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Index year", y = "Index relative to shared-year mean", colour = NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
)

terminal <- robustness |>
  dplyr::filter(year == max(base_index$year), panel != "all") |>
  dplyr::left_join(full, by = "year") |>
  dplyr::group_by(panel, run) |>
  dplyr::summarise(terminal_change = mean(relative / full - 1), runs = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
print(knitr::kable(terminal, digits = 3,
                   caption = "Mean relative change of the terminal-year index against the full model, per robustness run."))
```

<!-- Describe the supported finding and refer to @fig-robustness-section-runs. State how far the terminal year moves under subsampling and late data, and whether the start-year peels change the trend. -->
